description:
On Cassini in /fly, the CAPCOM event ticker shows every gravity-assist flyby (Venus #1, Venus #2, Earth, Jupiter) as 'FLYBY' with an empty note, instead of the per-flyby name and description stored in the mission data.

Expected: Each Cassini structural flyby event that has a `label` and `description` in `flight.events[]` should display those values in the CAPCOM ticker — the label as the event headline, the description as the note text below it.

Acceptance criteria:
- Cassini's Venus #1 flyby (met_days: 193) shows 'Venus #1 — gravity assist' as the event label in the /fly CAPCOM ticker, not 'FLYBY'. [reporter: 'On Cassini every flyby in the event ticker just says FLYBY with an empty note. The mission data definitely has proper names for these events.']
- Cassini's Venus #1 flyby shows 'First of four assists (1998-04-26). Cassini sweeps 284 km above Venus, stealing 7 km/s of orbital velocity from the planet to raise its aphelion outward.' as the event note, not an empty string. [repo-data: static/data/missions/saturn/cassini.json — flight.events[1].description = 'First of four assists...']
- Cassini's Venus #2, Earth, and Jupiter flybys each show their respective structural-event label ('Venus #2 — gravity assist', 'Earth — gravity assist', 'Jupiter — gravity assist') in the CAPCOM ticker, not 'FLYBY'. [repo-data: static/data/missions/saturn/cassini.json — flight.events[2-4].label values]
- Cassini's Venus #2, Earth, and Jupiter flybys each show their respective structural-event description as the note, not an empty string. [repo-data: static/data/missions/saturn/cassini.json — flight.events[2-4].description values]
- When a structural flight event has no `label` field, it still falls back to the type-based default label (e.g., 'FLYBY') — this is a regression guard for missions without per-event labels. [spec: static/data/schemas/mission.schema.json lines 340-344: 'Falls back to a humanised event-type when omitted.']
- When a structural flight event has no `description` field, it still falls back to an empty note — this is a regression guard for missions without per-event descriptions. [spec: static/data/schemas/mission.schema.json lines 346-350: 'Optional; the /fly chip collapses to label-only when absent.']
